ns2:section.sectionText: Supervised service learning activity related to the major of or career development within Molecular and Cellular Biology. Requires a Service Learning Proposal prior to the term, a minimum time commitment of 75 documented hours per credit hour within the term, regular documentation and reflection within the term, and a final culminating project at the end of the term. Please contact Dr. Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu for more information and approval.
